messages.subject: [Roxygen-devel] @slot tag
messages.body_plain:
Dear Roxygen developers,

I am curious about the status of the @slot tag in roxygen.
To me it seems it's not supported in neither the release version, nor the
SVN head. I am getting the following warning:
Warning in parse.warning(key, "is an unknown key") :
  @slot is an unknown key.
On the other hand there is an example in the sandbox.
Are you planning to support it in future versions of roxygen, is it already there
and I am missing something, or are there any alternatives?

Best regards,
Bastian Angermann.

messages.subject: [Roxygen-devel] Roxygen - question
messages.body_plain:
> Starting with small steps and a single file with R code, it is just
> not clear to me how to proceed with having the .Rd files generated.

The top-level Roxygen script expects a package, which you can generate
automatically around a single file with:

    package.skeleton('package', code_files='file.R')

If you want to forgo the package, however, you can operate on a single
file followingly:

    library(roxygen)
    make.Rd.roclet()$parse('file.R')

which will output an Rd translation (you can judge how useful that is
sans package).

Best, Peter
